name: Tuấn Lê
about: DevOps/Infrastructure Engineer with hands-on experience in enterprise banking environments. Specialized in Linux, Kubernetes, CI/CD automation, VMware infrastructure, and security operations.
objective: Focused on platform engineering and cloud-native technologies, with the goal of progressing into a Senior DevOps Engineer role.

experience.title: Infrastructure and DevOps Engineer
experience.description: Operating HSBC Internal Cloud with approximately 300 VMs; developing CI/CD using GitHub, Jenkins, Maven, Nexus, SonarQube, Sonatype IQ, Ansible, Kubernetes, and Helm. Automating patching, certificate renewal, and secrets management with HashiCorp Vault.

experience.title: System Engineer (Guardian – IT Onsite)
experience.description: Managed vCenter/vSphere infrastructure with 300+ Linux and Windows VMs; administered Veeam backup and recovery; built monitoring with Grafana, Prometheus, InfluxDB, and Telegraf. Deployed a three-node Kubernetes test cluster, automated VM provisioning with Terraform, and managed pfSense, Meraki, and Zabbix.

experience.title: System Engineer
experience.description: Managed Proxmox infrastructure with 100+ Linux VMs; automated VM deployment with Ansible; used Docker for Asterisk images supporting 3CX VoIP systems. Implemented OpenVPN for 20+ users and designed virtual network systems with VyOS.
